caveat: k=2 effect-size pairs from ONE RCT (Bastani et al. 2025, PNAS 122(26):e2422633122, n=2848 obs, 839 students). The between-condition p=0.016 assumes independence that does not hold; the within-study test (p=0.19, k=2) is the correct one and is underpowered. Reported as a worked example motivating the full systematic review, which remains future work.
